timing_critical_warning.text: Generated clock s3_hdmi_only_i/rgb2dvi_0/U0/SerialClk has no logical paths from master clock axi_dynclk_0_PXL_CLK_O.
timing_critical_warning.warning_location_note: The generated-clock declaration is in the RGB2DVI XDC; Vivado emitted the no-logical-path warning while processing the VTC clock-constraint context at line 2.
timing_critical_warning.observed_bd_connections: PixelClk is connected to axi_dynclk_0/PXL_CLK_O and SerialClk to axi_dynclk_0/PXL_CLK_5X_O; they are separate outputs of the dynamic-clock IP.
timing_critical_warning.assessment: The untouched baseline warning is directly triggered by this generated RGB2DVI clock relationship. A single-variable scratch run removing only this line eliminated Timing 38-249; this is causal diagnostic evidence, not project or implementation sign-off. The official reference RTL and BD route the 5x clock through BUFIO to SerialClk and derive PixelClk from that same fast source through BUFR divide-by-5, so the XDC describes the sibling clocks in the reverse parent-child direction. The scratch run retains an auto-derived 2 ns MMCM clock and its 10 ns BUFR-derived pixel clock, but four TMDS outputs still lack output delay and the synthesis timing summary still reports failing hold endpoints. No final project constraint change is accepted; clock/timing sign-off remains open.

pre_run_control.change: Removed only create_generated_clock -source [get_ports PixelClk] -multiply_by 5 [get_ports SerialClk]; retained the XDC header.

reference_clock_topology.rtl_and_bd_observation: axi_dynclk.vhd feeds PXL_CLK_5X_O from mmcm_clk through BUFIO and PXL_CLK_O from the same fast-clock source through BUFR_DIVIDE=5; the BD connects PXL_CLK_5X_O to rgb2dvi_0/SerialClk and PXL_CLK_O to rgb2dvi_0/PixelClk.
reference_clock_topology.interpretation_is_inference: The generated constraint models PixelClk as the parent of SerialClk, although the observed clock tree has the 2 ns MMCM clock as the parent and the 10 ns PixelClk as its divide-by-5 descendant.
